set.body:
Outcome

Define complete, canonical scientific axis identity without expanding Multivar for MVPA-specific needs.

Acceptance

- Ordered keys, coordinate basis, units, scale, and coordinate provenance participate in a versioned canonical fingerprint.
- Value provenance and descriptive tags remain separate from axis compatibility.
- Equal dimensions or labels never establish compatibility.
- Golden encodings and malformed-input refusals pass on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: P1.1: define the canonical scientific AxisIdentity protocol
